topic: Cida Bento lança audiobook de “O Pacto da Branquitude” Mundo Negro Brasil
insights: Cida Bento's audiobook of 'O Pacto da Branquitude' aims to broaden access to her critical analysis of racial dynamics and white privilege.
The audiobook is narrated by Vany Americo, enhancing the accessibility of the content.

Cida Bento's work has been recognized as a significant contribution to discussions on race and privilege, having been named one of the fifty most influential people in diversity by The Economist in 2015.

quotes.text: O Pacto da Branquitude denuncia e questiona a universalidade da branquitude e suas consequências nocivas para qualquer alteração substantiva na hierarquia das relações sociais.

summary: Cida Bento has released an audiobook version of her influential work 'O Pacto da Branquitude,' narrated by Vany Americo. This release is intended to expand access to her critical insights on racial dynamics and white privilege, which have garnered significant recognition in the field of diversity.
